text: Appeal of Order to Comply (April 29, 2019) for 225 Gladstone Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated April 29, 2019, regarding the property located at 225 Gladstone Avenue, Exterior Maintenance, Folder No. 19 144090 PRS 00 IV, and doing so granted an extension of time to September 30, 2019.
